title: 6-Month CGI Internship (Hamburg)
note: Product rendering and 3D animation internship; only for students who need a compulsory internship.

facts.summary: CGI intern at TEAMS Hamburg staging, rendering and animating product designs for consumer, mobility and professional-equipment clients.
facts.duties: Create virtual product photography and 3D animations; prepare models, materials and lighting; AI-assisted imaging and post-production.
facts.requirements: Enrolled student needing a required internship; basic Blender/3ds Max and/or Rhino, V-Ray or KeyShot, Adobe CC.
facts.apply: Email cover letter, CV and portfolio PDF (10-15MB max), or use the contact form.
